title: Trickling Deeper (ORIGINAL)
description: Drip. Drop. You love those words. They wrap around you without you ever really noticing how. And anything you do notice, you just enjoy. The only thing that really matters is that it feels good. This want which percolates through you. You want me to continue playing with you like this. You need more of it. You desire more of it. Wrapping your brain deeper and deeper down. Creating a pattern. When I say it, you do it. And each time you hear a word it becomes easier and easier. By the time I'm done with you, you'll be nothing but a Drip... Drip... Drip... As my words surround you, and you Drop... Drop... Drop...
author: Mistress Shibby
